title: Replay a funded chart-267 contact and the two-terminal rank cut
body:

The source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. Extract `research/p104-bit267-paid-crossfeed/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. Cold dual implementations reproduced the operator, full exact invoice, protected labels and corruption controls. Hosted execution is separate.
